newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kondpetroleum H1 pretax loss 466 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Kondpetroleum H1 pretax loss 466 bln rbls.

text.p: The pretax loss at Russian oil company AOOT Kondpetroleum, one of the main operating units of NK Sidanko, rose to 465.90 billion roubles from 117.75 billion roubles in the same period of 1995, Sidanko said on Tuesday.
NOTE - Comparisons for capital and reserves, accounts payable and receivable December 31, 1995. Comparisons for oil production total 1995, not first half.

Kondpetroleum 1995 total loss was 296.10 billion roubles, compared with 247.60 billion roubles in 1994. Full name OAO Kondpetroleum. It is one of the three main operating units of NK Sidanko, which owns 51 percent of the shares.
The two other companies are Varyoganneftegaz and Chernogorneft.

These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
